title: processkit.lock
description: The lock file in the repository root (inheritance@v1 PK-INH-002, PK-INH-040, PK-INH-041). processkit writes it with the JSON serialization of repository-storage@v1 PK-STORE-049 (sorted keys, two-space indent, one LF at the end); it is a plan target under repository-storage@v1 PK-STORE-056.

apiVersion.description: Lock format version. processkit version --json reports this value as lockFormatVersion (cli@v1 PK-OUT-010).

upstreams.description: One entry for every declared upstream and every transitive upstream, sorted by name in ascending Unicode code point order; each name at most once. Empty when no upstream is declared.

entryName.description: Entry name: the declared upstream name, or for a transitive upstream the entry name of the upstream whose lock introduced it, '/', and its entry name in that lock (for example platform/company).

commit.description: Full Git commit ID in lowercase hexadecimal (40 digits for SHA-1, 64 for SHA-256 repositories).

digest.description: Content digest of the commit (inheritance@v1 PK-INH-038).

source.description: The source exactly as declared (in processkit.toml for a declared upstream, in the introducing upstream's lock for a transitive one).
